text: The Vidu open platform currently supports a wide range of features, covering video, audio, image, and creative use cases across various development scenarios. The function list is continuously updated: **Primary Function** **Secondary Function** **Function Details** **Video Generation** [**Image to Video**](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/image-to-video) **Generate a video from an input image and prompt description** - Freely select the video's aspect ratio, duration, resolution, and motion amplitude - Support for adding background music - Support for selecting multiple generation modes [**Reference to Video**](https://vidu-platform-next.dev.shu.team/docs/reference-to-video) **Generate a video that references the subject or scene of input images** - Support for uploading multiple images - Freely select the video's aspect ratio, duration, resolution, and motion amplitude - Support for adding background music - Support for selecting multiple generation modes [**Start-End Frame to Video**](https://vidu-platform-next.dev.shu.team/docs/start-end-to-video) **Input a start frame image and an end frame image, and generate a video based on the prompt** - Freely select the video's aspect ratio, duration, resolution, and motion amplitude - Support for adding background music - Support for selecting multiple generation modes [**Text to Video**](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/text-to-video) **Generate a video directly from a prompt describing the scene** - Support for long text descriptions - Freely select the video's aspect ratio, duration, resolution, and motion amplitude - Support for adding background music - Support for selecting multiple generation modes **Real-Time Interactive Digital Human** [**Avatar Real-Time Edition**](https://platform.vidu.cn/vidu-stream/doc/s2-avatar/realtime/introduction) Input an image, persona, and user audio/video for real-time conversation Real-time interaction where the digital human converses with the user in real time, supports interruption, and has bidirectional perception. Vidu S provides the full pipeline from speech to rendering [**Avatar Component Edition**](https://platform.vidu.cn/vidu-stream/doc/s2-avatar/component/introduction) Generate real-time video by referencing digital human audio + action text Real-time interaction — you already have your own RTC channel and real-time voice capability; Vidu S only needs to render the digital human and stream it to your channel [**Avatar Non-Real-Time Edition**](https://platform.vidu.cn/vidu-stream/doc/s2-avatar/async/introduction) Input a digital human image + digital human audio + action text to generate a video file Asynchronous generation — one character image + one audio clip (or text) generates a speaking video with aligned lip sync and movement [**Editing Edition**](https://platform.vidu.cn/vidu-stream/doc/s2-editing/quick-start) Input a user audio/video stream + replacement image to generate a real-time video Streaming video editing: continuously receives a video stream and outputs the edited result in real time, with the ability to switch the reference image or scene mid-stream without interrupting the stream **Image Generation** [**Reference to Image**](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/reference-to-image) **Generate an image that references the subject or scene of input images** - Support for uploading multiple images - Image characters, objects, and scenes remain highly consistent throughout - Freely select the image's aspect ratio and resolution, with support for 2K and 4K [**Text to Image**](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/reference-to-image) **Generate an image directly from a prompt describing the scene** - Support for long text descriptions - Freely select the image's aspect ratio and resolution, with support for 2K and 4K [**Image Editing**](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/reference-to-image) **Reference an original image and a reference image to replace elements in the original image** - Support for uploading multiple images - Support for replacing elements in the original image via text description - Freely select the image's aspect ratio and resolution, with support for 2K and 4K **Audio Generation** [**Text to Audio**](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/text-to-audio) **Generate audio directly from a prompt** - Support for generating creative sound effects or various types of background music - Freely select the audio duration [**Controllable Text to Sound Effects**](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/timing-to-audio) **Generate controllable, time-sequenced sound effects directly from a prompt** - Use a timeline to flexibly control the order and duration of multiple sound effects - Support for overlapping multiple sound effects - Freely select the audio duration [Text to Speech](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/text-to-speech) **Generate speech from text** - Control speech rate, pauses, volume, and polyphonic character pronunciation - Freely adjust speech emotion, such as happy, sad, or angry - Support for 30+ languages and 300+ voice options [Voice Cloning](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/voice-clone) **Upload audio to clone a voice** - Invoke the cloned voice for speech synthesis at any time - Freely adjust speech emotion, such as happy, sad, or angry **Template Usage** [**Scene Templates**](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/template) **Input an image and apply an effects template with one click to generate a video** - Covers hundreds of creative templates: French kiss, journey through the universe series, and more [**Template-Based Compilations**](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/template-story) **Input an image and apply a long-video template with one click to generate a compiled video** - The resulting compilation has a coherent storyline and diverse effects **Additional Capabilities** [**Lip Sync**](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/lip-sync) **Make a character in a video lip-sync to a specified text** - Freely select from hundreds of voices and languages - Support for long text input - Freely adjust volume and speech rate [Digital Human](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/digital-human) **Generate a digital human video for a character in an image** - Enable the digital human to deliver speeches, broadcasts, and other content - Support for speech synthesis using 300+ voices or cloned voices [**Video Extension**](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/video-extension) **Extend the duration of a video** - Support for extending by 1 to 7 seconds [Smart Multi-Frame](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/multi-frame) **Input multiple keyframes to continue a video** - Use keyframes to generate high-quality videos with a coherent plot and consistent characters - Freely control the duration between frames, selectable from 2 to 7 seconds - Each frame can use a prompt to control the visual effect [**Recommended Prompts**](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/prompt-rec) **Input an image to generate corresponding recommended prompts** - Support for selecting the prompt type and quantity - Support for selecting the video resolution [**Smart Ultra HD - Premium**](https://platform.vidu.cn/docs/upscale-pro) **Enhance the resolution of a video** - Freely select from multiple resolutions: 1080p, 2K, 4K, 8K
